needs_review.issue: Siberia workers not surfaced in direct person pages
needs_review.finding: Search for Siberia/Sakha/Tuvan ministry returned organizational context and partnerships (Bible translation) but no individual person pages. Mention of 'The Moles' joined Russian team but no citable URL.
needs_review.evidence: Query results mentioned Sakha churches and Tuvan Bible translation partnerships but linked to organizational pages, not individual pages
needs_review.recommendation: Siberia workers may be published with first names only per brief protection rules. No records should be emitted without full names and citable pages. Current state is compliant.

needs_review.issue: Potential retirees referenced but not examined
needs_review.finding: Multiple search results included links to interactministries.org/retired/ which is a documented retiree trap per brief. No records were extracted from retired pages; the trap was successfully avoided.
needs_review.evidence: Retired path appeared in 7+ search results but was never accessed or cited for any person record
needs_review.recommendation: No action required; retiree trap was correctly avoided.

needs_review.issue: Thiessen family mentioned in blog article only
needs_review.finding: Roy and Laura Thiessen mentioned in 2016 blog post (interactministries.org/2016/08/26/roy-and-laura-thiessen-canada/) but no individual person page in the standard URL pattern was found.
needs_review.evidence: Search result showed 'Thiessen - Roy and Laura - Canada' linked from /category/canada/ but source was dated blog article, not personal giving page
needs_review.recommendation: Per enumeration rules, source_url must be person's own page, not news/blog. No record emitted. If standard page exists at /thiessen-roy-laura/ or similar, it may have been missed.

needs_review.issue: Dave Hill spouse Sally mentioned as deceased
needs_review.finding: Search results mention 'Dave Hill and his late wife Sally served with InterAct as church planters.' Sally is deceased.
needs_review.evidence: Search result explicitly states 'late wife Sally' in historical context
needs_review.recommendation: Per enumeration rules, deceased people should not be emitted as prospects. Only Dave Hill was recorded. Sally Hill correctly excluded.

needs_review.issue: URL pattern variation with -and- found in four records
needs_review.finding: Four couple pages use alternate slug format with hyphenated 'and': /dalton-aaron-and-tisha/, /sewell-joel-and-amanda/, /chinn-andy-and-jesi/, /beutler-josh-and-joylynn/. Standard pattern examples omit 'and'.
needs_review.evidence: Search results consistently returned these URLs with '-and-' preserved; titles confirmed couples (e.g., 'Dalton, Aaron & Tisha')
needs_review.recommendation: Pattern confirmed valid per organization's URL structure. All four couples cited with full details. Slug format variation does not prevent citation.

needs_review.issue: Henry, Dave's spouse Kay mentioned but no separate page found
needs_review.finding: Dave Henry's wife Kay mentioned in search results as co-translator of Koyukon New Testament but no individual page URL was discovered for her.
needs_review.evidence: Search result description: 'Dave and his wife Kay began their ministry in Alaska by translating portions of the New Testament under Wycliffe with the Koyukon Indians'
needs_review.recommendation: Per enumeration rules requiring named person pages: Kay Henry not emitted without her own URL. Only Dave Henry recorded as single person from that couple.
